title: Larger product video gallery verified
summary: Video frames now use the larger photo stage with stable gallery navigation.

changes.detail: Video gallery now shares the responsive photo height, removing the short forced 16:9 stage while retaining contain fitting without cropping.

validation.name: Browser sizing and navigation
validation.detail: Isolated Edge test with synthetic product and intercepted local 1280x720 MP4: frames measured 320x358, 390x437 and 490x490. Next/previous media retained gallery navigation position. Video metadata loaded successfully.

validation.name: Whitespace and history integrity
validation.detail: git diff --check and change-report --check passed; append-only follow-up checked again after append.

validation.name: Validation limitations
validation.detail: Original remote test clip failed to load; real product video playback and native devices not verified. Local fixture verifies rendering and size only. Initial offscreen video-height assertion was invalid because the paged video leaves view; corrected to measure gallery navigation position. No deployment.
